thread:
maria: Heads up — customers in eu-west seeing a sudden bump in 5xx and request timeouts starting ~09:22 UTC. Multiple support tickets opened.
aj: seeing the same in dashboards, spike on gateway errors and a lot of 504s from the ingress pipeline.
sre_lead: war room opened. tagging infra and runtime. @eng_runtime can you join? ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-4456 and pinged on-call.
eng_runtime: joining, grabbing logs now. initial read: proxy-to-runtime latency increasing then circuit-breaker trips. KV-cache miss ratio shot up at the same time.
support_jay: some customers report auth failures too (403 -> then 504). could be upstream timeouts causing auth retries.
maria: quick mitigation idea — can we temporarily route eu-west traffic to dedicated pool in other region while we triage?
eng_runtime: can do a targeted route for a subset (10%) for immediate relief. will open a rollout.
ben: I'm seeing frequent `connection reset by peer` in runtime logs and kvcache eviction floods. attaching short snippet: ```
[09:22:11] kvcache: eviction spike: 2.1M keys/sec
[09:22:12] runtime: grpc dial error: connection reset by peer
[09:22:14] gateway: 504 upstream timeout (deadline exceeded)
```
natacha: interesting — autoscaler logs show a backlog but no new pod creation for ~45s, scale policy backoff kicked in.
aj: could be interplay between autoscaler cooldown + sudden prefix invalidation (cache invalidation) causing load surge.
sre_lead: mitigation checklist: 1) roll 10% traffic to dedicated eu-west fallback pool, 2) temporarily raise proxy CB threshold, 3) disable aggressive kvcache eviction policy, 4) notify customers. who wants items 1/2/3?
eng_runtime: I'll handle 2 and 3 now. applying `gateway.circuit_breaker.max_conns=2000` and `kvcache.eviction_rate_limit=off` for eu-west.
maria: I'll coordinate routing (item 1) and send a short customer note for impacted accounts (item 4).
support_jay: creating a single unified support blurb to send and attach known repro steps.
eng_runtime: applied CB change and kv cache tweak at 09:26 UTC. observing 5xx drop from 27% -> 6% within 2 min.
ben: after changes gateway errors trending down, but some auth failures persisted for customers behind the auth proxy — looks like auth proxy also hit resource limits and started returning 502.
sre_lead: for auth-proxy, spin up two extra replicas in eu-west pool and add horizontal buffer. ben doing that?
ben: spawning extras now. happened at 09:30 UTC. auth failures dropped.
maria: routing 15% to dedicated fallback at 09:31 — metrics show error rate on main pool decreasing.
aj: can we reproduce locally? provide minimal repro steps in the thread.
eng_runtime: repro (sanity):
1) send high qps with varied prompt lengths that invalidate KV prefix frequently
2) throttle autoscaler so pods don't come up quickly
3) observe kvcache eviction + auth retries causing CB trips
Example curl snippet: ```bash
for i in {1..2000}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"long prompt'$i'"}' https://api.eu-west.redwood.ai/v1/generate & done
```
support_jay: added that curl to the support ticket and linked to INC-2026-4456.
sre_lead: good containment. next: postmortem actions. please add assignees.
eng_runtime: action: add smoother kvcache eviction ramp and a circuit-breaker-aware autoscale policy. assign to me and aj. ETA 2 weeks.
ben: action: auth-proxy capacity test and add warm replicas for cold-start protection. assign to ben. ETA 1 week.
maria: action: customer communication follow-up + credits review for impacted orgs. assign to maria and support_jay. ETA 3 days.
aj: action: add synthetic load test that simulates prefix-churn for CI. assign to aj. ETA 2 weeks.
sre_lead: action: dashboard alert tuning — make an alert for combined metrics (kvcache eviction rate + CB trips) so we detect earlier. assign to natacha. ETA 5 days.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-4456 status: mitigated -> monitoring.
maria: I'll draft a short postmortem and ping for reviews. key root cause hypothesis: sudden prefix churn causing massive cache eviction -> upstream latency spike -> auth proxy/backpressure -> CB trips + autoscaler backoff -> 5xx/timeouts.
eng_runtime: will collect heap/kvcache metrics, autoscaler events, and gateway traces for the postmortem. uploading artifacts to the incident folder.
support_jay: customers updated and offered credits for impacted windows. keeping tickets open until postmortem publish.
sre_lead: closing war room. keep thread for follow-ups and please update assignees in the incident board. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
